notes: Hollow has the CEO's two jack-o-lanterns in the near lower-right corner, in front of the fog and the ghost (art/hollow-pumpkins.webp + hollow-pumpkins-glow.webp). They are cut from his picture with a solid traced outline, the green smoke…

Each lantern's candle flickers on its own: quick small wavers and an occasional gutter, lighting its carved face and throwing a warm pool of light that breathes with the flame. They appear in both Hollow and Vigil.
